However Nishimura suggests that they spend the rest of their lives in their new bodies..? A tale of how two people cope with the ups and downs of youth, while in each other's bodies!

title: Koi Inu
synopsis: Igarashi is now in college. The bittersweet memories that he left behind in childhood are now beginning to resurface when he meets his childhood friend Chiyo-chan again after 10 years.
